parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: The personal access token. This parameter is not required if you use an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair or Security Token Service (STS) credentials to authenticate your identity.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The organization ID. You can obtain the ID from the URL of your organization in Alibaba Cloud DevOps. The URL is in the format `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Valid values: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: repositoryIdentity
parameters.description: The ID or full path of the repository.

parameters.name: sha
parameters.description: The commit ID. You must provide the SHA value of the commit.
